entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: Goldstone radar reaches this repository through NASA's Planetary Data System Small Bodies Node, not an observatory archive: a dedicated Geographos dataset, and compilations of radar detections and shape models, several of which combine Goldstone transmissions with Arecibo or DSS-13 reception. No bulk raw Goldstone bundle was found, and the radar group's own site publishes no archive.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Planetary Data System data are in the public domain and are expected to be cited when used. No separate Goldstone data policy was found.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: Only finished products are distributed: radar shape models come from the SHAPE code lineage, for which no public distribution or licence was found.
entries.revisitWhen: A radar shape-model code is published openly, or raw radar data are archived.
